about_the_game:
Toledo Park Quest is an engaging and educational 2D platformer where players become young guardians on a mission to restore and protect the parks of Toledo. Developed in partnership with the City of Toledo’s Department of Parks & Youth Services and BESN X Community, the game combines exploration, environmental awareness, and light puzzle-solving in a fun, story-driven experience.

Players will explore real-world inspired locations like Ottawa Park and the Police Museum, collecting trash, repairing landmarks, and uncovering clues to stop the mysterious forces damaging the parks. Each level introduces new challenges and mini-games that teach the importance of community care, sustainability, and teamwork.

Key Features:

  • 🌳 Explore Toledo’s Parks: Traverse beautifully illustrated 2D environments inspired by real locations.

  • 🧹 Clean and Restore: Collect litter, fix objects, and bring nature back to life through interactive missions.

  • 🕵️‍♀️ Solve Mysteries: Follow clues to uncover who or what is harming the parks.

  • 🎮 Accessible Gameplay: Simple controls and educational storytelling designed for players of all ages.

  • 🏆 Learn & Grow: Earn achievements while discovering fun facts about local history and the environment.

Join the guardians, protect Toledo’s parks, and make your community shine again!

  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or Apple M1
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or Apple M1 GPU)
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX

short_description: Toledo Park Quest is a 2D adventure platformer where players become park guardians aiding Hoot the Owl to restore Toledo’s parks. Clean litter, solve puzzles, and face mischievous foes like Joe the Raccoon and the mysterious Night Jogger to save the city and the park.
